_why: Reviewers whose testimonial must NEVER be published on the site or emitted as Review JSON-LD, because publishing it would be an undisclosed material connection. FTC Act Section 5 and the FTC endorsement guides treat a review from someone with a family or employment relationship as deceptive unless that relationship is disclosed. Before 2026-07-26 this exclusion existed only in one person's memory: there was no denylist, no flag, and no note anywhere in the repo, so any future rebuild of reviews.json from a live Google read would have quietly reintroduced it.
_enforced_by: scripts/lint-copy.mjs, rule id 'excluded-reviewer'. It fails --strict if a listed name appears in site/src/data/reviews.json or in any built page. Enforcement, not documentation, is the point of this file.
_important: These reviews are excluded from PUBLICATION only. They still exist on Google and still count toward the live rating and review total that reviews_meta.json records. Do NOT subtract them from AggregateRating: the schema must match what a person sees on the Google profile, and understating it is its own accuracy problem.
